hero.kicker: Software that moves your business forward
hero.subtitulo: We build custom software and automate processes with the agility of the wind. Lightweight, fast and accessible applications, backed by solid code and exceptional teamwork.

servicios.subtitulo: Tailor-made tech solutions that move your business forward with the agility of the wind.

web.descripcion: We craft lightweight, fast and accessible apps and platforms. We bring your idea to any screen with intuitive design and impeccable code.

ia.descripcion: Your time is valuable. We remove manual work from your company by automating processes and integrating AI agents that work for you 24/7.

apis.descripcion: We make your tools talk to each other. We connect your current systems so information flows without barriers or interruptions.

cloud.descripcion: Give your infrastructure a breather. We migrate legacy systems to modern technologies or the cloud to make them safer, more efficient and scalable.

consultoria.descripcion: We guide you every step of the way. We analyze your business and chart the fastest, most effective tech route for your digital transformation.

proceso.subtitulo: An iterative, transparent cycle: you always know which phase your project is in and you see real progress every week.
proceso.hint: Tap a phase to see the details

ciclo.subtitulo: Every phase has a clear goal, an estimated duration and a concrete deliverable we review with you.

descubrimiento.descripcion: We understand your business, your users and the real problem. We define scope, priorities and how success will be measured.

diseno.descripcion: We prototype flows and interfaces before writing code, so you validate the experience from day one.

desarrollo.descripcion: We build in short cycles with frequent deliveries. You see working progress every week, not at the end.

pruebas.descripcion: Automated and manual testing on every delivery: performance, security and accessibility before going live.

despliegue.descripcion: We publish to the cloud with continuous integration, monitoring and backups. A launch with no surprises.

evolucion.descripcion: We measure, listen and improve. Support, maintenance and new features whenever your business needs them.

nosotros.titulo: Agility, solid code and an exceptional team
nosotros.p1: At WindKode we build custom software and automate processes with the agility of the wind. We deliver lightweight, fast and accessible applications that solve each user's specific needs.
nosotros.p2: Behind every project there is solid code, best practices from the very first commit, and exceptional teamwork — with you as part of the process.

rapido.descripcion: Optimized applications that load in the blink of an eye.

seguro.descripcion: Robust code and best practices from the first commit.

colaborativo.descripcion: Exceptional teamwork, with you as part of the process.

equipo.subtitulo: Hands-on leadership and an agile team behind it, obsessed with quality.

areas.subtitulo: More than two names: specialized areas working together so every delivery ships fast, solid and well tested.

desarrollo.descripcion: Frontend, backend and mobile. They turn ideas into lightweight, fast applications with clean code.

qa.descripcion: They test every feature before it reaches your hands. Nothing ships without passing through here.

diseno.descripcion: Clear, accessible interfaces designed so any user understands them at first glance.

ventas.descripcion: They listen to your needs and turn them into a concrete proposal, no detours and no fine print.

soporte.descripcion: They stay with you after launch: maintenance, improvements and fast response.

infraestructura.descripcion: Cloud, deployments and automation so everything runs safely and without interruptions.

proyectos.subtitulo: Every project is a story of code, design and collaboration.
proyectos.vacio: We will share our projects here soon.

agenda.subtitulo: Tell us your idea and we'll turn it into software. Book a no-strings call and let's chart your project's route together.

exito.mensaje: Your mail app opened with the message drafted. Just hit send and we'll get back to you soon.

contacto.whatsapp_mensaje: Hi WindKode 👋 I'd like to ask about a software project.
